text:
13 Oct. 2019 writing case notes

You are the GP of Mr David Coop who has ongoing gastric problems

Background:

      Age: 54 years
      Job: construction worker
      Social: married with 3 children
      Intermittent smoker since a teen (currently 10 cigs per day)
      Likes football, sports

Family history:
   Parents deceased 1979
   Father had hiatus hernia 1973

Medical history:
   1997: IBD (dietary management)
   2000: conjunctivitis (no ttt)
   2006: Tenosynovitis ( NSAIDS)
   2010: abdominal tenderness, bloating, flatulence
     Endoscopy: no evidence of duodenal ulcer, gastric cancer
   2016: recurrent conjunctivitis ( eye drops)
   13/06/2019: recurrent reflux, heartburn, nausea

*Medications:
   2006: Naproxin sodium (anti-inflammatory)
   2010: peppermint oil 1x3 daily
   2016: chloramphenicol (for conjunctivitis)
   13/06/2019: ranitidine 150mg b.d

Presenting complaint:
      ↑ long term gastric problems
 
Subjective: abdominal tenderness, reflux, heartburn, nausea
Objective: abdominal tenderness by palpation
Provisional diagnosis:
       ?reflux (? Weakness of lower oesophageal sphincter- ? work stress
       and smoking)
       ? Duodenal ulcer
       ? Gastric cancer
       ? Chronic gastritis
Plan:
           Only Discussed (avoid smoking and heavy lifting)- rest from
              work- he was concerned about future re employ
           Note for 14 days off work
           Refer to a specialist for evaluation and endoscopy

Writing task:
Write a letter of referral to Dr Christine Pearson, gastroenterologist, to ask
for the necessary test and a general opinion about Mr Coop’s condition.
